column2: Freeze transparent policies, scenario/seed set, evaluator and budget; execute all policies and independently recompute baseline measurements.
column3: Missing attempts, undisclosed adaptive policy changes or budget excess fails; superiority is not required.

column2: Run seeded random search twice under identical bounds and compare proposal sequence, failures and retained outcomes.
column3: A changed sequence without changed seed/version or omitted failures breaks deterministic replay.

column2: Exercise a bounded agent search with separately approved inference and simulation limits and retain both cost ledgers.
column3: Continuing after either approved limit or hiding inference cost fails budget enforcement.

column2: Compare methods under the same declared compute and ecological constraints with explicit justified exceptions.
column3: An undisclosed larger budget or looser constraint invalidates a matched comparison.

column2: Force invalid and crashed proposals and inspect consumed budget and outcome denominators.
column3: Treating failed proposals as free or deleting them fails accounting.

column2: Submit a candidate whose apparent improvement moves pollution outside the protected accounting boundary.
column3: The candidate must fail the displacement constraint rather than win on the truncated score.

column2: Run matched repetitions under admitted seeds and report variability and uncertainty in differences.
column3: A superiority claim based on one unreplicated favorable run fails.

column2: Inspect committed shortlisted identities and selection criteria dated before holdout access.
column3: Adding a winner after seeing holdout results invalidates the frozen shortlist.

column2: Execute every reserved condition for each frozen strategy with unchanged evaluator and limits.
column3: Omitting a failed condition or retuning against it fails confirmation.

column2: Reconcile downstream and custody burdens alongside direct metrics and flag controlling omitted pathways.
column3: An excluded controlling pollution destination defeats an unqualified tradeoff claim.

column2: Read null, harmful and favorable outcomes together with attempted-case counts.
column3: Selective omission of a negative or indistinguishable result fails reporting.

column2: Audit the full tested-candidate table, selection rule and uncertainty treatment for multiplicity effects.
column3: Reporting only the selected winner without the search context fails the claim audit.

column2: Independently recompute ordering from retained records and compare quantities, rounding and validity filters.
column3: A disagreement cannot be resolved by silently adopting the first calculation; retain and investigate it.

column2: Map each confirmed claim to its supported domain and passed holdout conditions.
column3: A failed condition must narrow scope; extrapolating beyond the evidence fails.

column2: Navigate study to source to attempt and back through two versions in the delivered interface.
column3: Ambiguous identity, overwritten history or a link to the wrong attempt fails lineage navigation.

column2: For every map inspect the equivalent keyboard-accessible table with the same units and missingness.
column3: A mapped value absent from the table or missingness encoded as zero fails equivalence.

column2: Select a captured quantity and follow each transfer to terminal fate and uncertainty.
column3: A broken custody link or safe-disposal label for unknown fate fails drilldown.

column2: Compare aligned runs, then try mismatched units, supports, models and unassessed quantities.
column3: The interface must reject or explicitly qualify mismatches rather than display a false direct comparison.

column2: Inspect separately labeled numerical, parameter and scenario ranges and their textual explanation.
column3: An unlabeled merged interval or inaccessible explanation fails uncertainty comprehension.

column2: With a real tester, navigate comparison and export by keyboard and screen reader, including cancel/reopen/error/retry; record focus, names and retained selection.
column3: A keyboard trap, lost focus/selection or absent human assistive observation leaves the workflow incomplete.

column2: Inspect narrow viewport and zoomed layouts with full data labels, warnings and usable comparison/export controls.
column3: Clipped warnings, inaccessible offscreen controls or lost units fails responsiveness.

column2: Measure the existing serial workload and compare it with an approved resource envelope before proposing workers.
column3: Unmeasured need or an unapproved concurrency increase cannot pass adoption.

column2: Run an intentionally excessive synthetic study under the already approved CPU/time/storage limits.
column3: It must stop with retained diagnostics before exceeding the enforced limit; truncating evidence silently fails.

column2: Cancel a bounded multi-attempt study and inspect every complete and incomplete attempt after restart.
column3: Deleting a completed bundle or labeling unfinished work complete fails cancellation.

column2: Repeat a deliberately interrupted dispatch with the same attempt identity and inspect activation history.
column3: More than one complete activation for that attempt fails duplicate safety.

column2: Exercise expired ownership and restart while a competing worker attempts to claim the same synthetic bundle.
column3: Two concurrent writers or an unverified stale-time takeover fails ownership recovery.

column2: Apply retention to a fixture containing both uncited and cited/dependent artifacts.
column3: Deleting cited evidence without explicit dependency handling fails retention safety.

column2: Run separately approved synthetic adversarial filesystem/network probes at the adapter boundary and retain denied and allowed controls.
column3: An escape or a claim based solely on subprocess separation blocks untrusted execution.

column2: Compare the second case's declared support/forcing and challenged conclusions with the first case.
column3: A relabeled identical case cannot establish transfer or independent replication.

column2: Obtain the lawful case package without private inputs and verify complete study metadata and source rights.
column3: Any missing private dependency or unresolved redistribution right blocks external reproduction.

column2: Have the actual contributor record exact public artifact, environment and commands performed.
column3: A copied maintainer log or invented participant cannot establish external execution.

column2: Record every transfer discrepancy, unsupported input and failed assumption with the corresponding attempt.
column3: Hiding a failed case from the public evidence fails retention.

column2: Compare independent source/study hashes, admitted tolerances and model assumptions before resolving numerical differences.
column3: An unexplained discrepancy or modified tolerance after observation remains unresolved.

column2: Collect separately scoped qualified reviews of conservation and ecological interpretation for the exact replicated result.
column3: Correct accounting alone cannot satisfy ecological review, and missing qualifications remain pending.

column2: Observe an actual consenting user compare two retained runs, explain inputs/limits, export and reopen the selected evidence; record assistance and defects.
column3: An incorrect or unreopenable export fails; implementation fixes require a separately scoped follow-up.

column2: Extract the delivered study archive fresh and locate original inputs, model/evaluator identity, diagnostics and reproduction instructions.
column3: Missing original data or an unverifiable identity prevents a portable-study claim.

column2: Enumerate every distributed component and match its exact version to license and attribution in the archive.
column3: One component without applicable rights/notices blocks distribution.

column2: Compare release notes against retained failed/unsupported cases and model-card limits.
column3: Selective omission of known failures or hidden applicability limits fails release documentation.

column2: Review exact artifact hash, destination, outstanding risks and actual owner authorization before release.
column3: Approval for a different version or destination cannot authorize this artifact.

column2: Publish a bounded correction record linking superseded and replacement identities while preserving the old evidence.
column3: Overwriting the old claim with no traceable correction history fails provenance.

column2: Check documented supported environments against actual packaged evidence and inspect compatibility/migration bounds.
column3: An untested platform or unsupported migration presented as verified fails the support claim.

column2: Inspect release text and interfaces for the explicit no-field-action boundary and evidence-bounded claims.
column3: Physical deployment/control or unsupported cleanup/lifecycle/ecological/health promises fail release scope.
